one_line: Mahavira, the Jain ascetic hero of the Naya clan, and Chetaka, republican chief of Licchavis in early historic north Bihar.

appearance.age_look: Mahavira appears as a lean man in his mid-30s with an athletic but ascetic build; Chetaka appears in his late 40s with a stately, broad-shouldered frame.
appearance.face: Mahavira has an oval face, warm wheat-brown complexion, straight nose, high cheekbones, and calm, wide anime eyes with a steady, compassionate gaze and a faint serene smile; Chetaka has a squarer jaw, slightly deeper brown complexion, strong nose, neat beard along jaw and chin, and sharp, observant eyes with a dignified, confident expression.
appearance.hair: Mahavira’s hair is dark brown, pulled back into a simple tight knot at the back of the head with a few soft strands framing the temples, no ornament; Chetaka’s dark brown hair is tied in a neat topknot (small knot at crown) under a plain, narrow cloth band in dull maroon wrapped once around his head like a simple early turban strip.
appearance.costume: Mahavira wears an era-evocative, modest early Jain mendicant outfit based on north Indian 6th-century BCE garments: a plain unstitched off-white cotton upper cloth (uttariya) draped over both shoulders and hanging to mid-thigh, and a matching off-white lower cloth (dhoti-like strip) wrapped firmly from waist to just above the ankles, both simple, undecorated and slightly worn, with bare forearms and feet but overall fully covered and modest; Chetaka wears a refined republican chieftain’s attire: a knee-length, straight-cut, long-sleeved tunic (angarkha-like) in muted indigo-blue cotton with a simple wrap closure tied at the right side, a plain pale-cream lower wrap (dhoti-style) pleated and tied at the waist falling to the ankles, and a broad dark-maroon sash (patka) wrapped around his waist and hanging down the left side, all in matte handwoven textures with minimal ornament, complemented by simple brown leather sandals and a narrow bronze armlet on his right upper arm and a single bronze bangle on his left wrist.
appearance.signature: Mahavira carries a simple off-white Jain-style peacock-feather whisk (rajoharana) with a short wooden handle wrapped in plain cloth, while Chetaka carries a modest early iron-tipped spear about his own height with a wooden shaft and a narrow leaf-shaped point, the spear kept upright beside him as a symbol of republican authority rather than aggression.

ref_desc: Mahavira is a lean wheat-brown man with an oval face, calm wide eyes, dark-brown hair in a simple back knot, dressed in plain off-white upper and lower cloths and carrying an off-white peacock-feather whisk, while Chetaka is a broad-shouldered, bearded darker-brown man with a neat topknot, wearing a muted indigo long-sleeved tunic over a pale-cream lower wrap with a dark-maroon waist sash, simple bronze jewellery and sandals, holding a wooden-shaft spear with an iron tip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet showing two standing figures side by side, Mahavira and Chetaka, in early historic north Bihar style: Mahavira is a lean, mid-30s wheat-brown man with an oval face, calm wide eyes and a serene faint smile, dark-brown hair pulled into a simple knot at the back with a few strands at the temples, wearing a plain off-white cotton upper cloth draped over both shoulders to mid-thigh and a matching off-white lower wrap tied around his waist down to his ankles, modest and undecorated, bare forearms and feet, holding an off-white peacock-feather whisk with a short cloth-wrapped wooden handle in his right hand; beside him Chetaka is a late-40s broad-shouldered, slightly darker-brown man with a square jaw, neat jawline beard and moustache, strong nose and sharp, dignified eyes, his dark-brown hair tied in a small topknot under a narrow dull-maroon cloth band around his head, wearing a muted indigo-blue, long-sleeved, knee-length wrap tunic tied on the right side over a pale-cream dhoti-like lower wrap down to the ankles, a broad dark-maroon waist sash wrapped and hanging on the left, simple brown leather sandals, a narrow bronze armlet on his right upper arm and a single bronze bangle on his left wrist, holding a wooden-shaft spear with a narrow iron tip upright by his side; use a restrained palette of off-white, muted indigo blue, dark maroon, pale cream and brown, with clean linework and consistent details visible from front, three-quarter and back views.
